scopeReview: PSO-2.E–F: age structure, sex ratios, population pyramids, differing scales and potential markets/services. All three pyramids use common denominators, symmetric axes and ten-year cohorts0–79;80+ is explicitly open. No exact birth rate, life expectancy, demographic stage or unique cause is inferred from shape alone.
varietyReview: Three distinct original pyramids and one age-group table; other tasks distinguish stock/flow, cohort aging, ratio/share, local specialization, absolute/relative size and median/mean. Varied keys and difficulty with explicit data interpretation rather than shape labels alone.
repetitionReview: No reuse of prior density calculations as age-composition items. Under20 share, age-specific sex ratio, dependency ratio and older-share comparison use different quantities. The temporal-cohort and current-birth questions assess distinct projection versus inference limits.
